name.description: client_name, shown on Companies' consent pages

published_key_files.description: keys whose public halves are in the key set but are never signed with: the next key before a rotation, the previous one after it

redirect_uri.description: where Direct Sign-In returns the User, an HTTPS URL on the client_id's host; default <client_id origin>/companies/callback. Listed in the document's redirect_uris when a Company lists direct

serve.description: serve the client metadata document and key set on the A2A listener at their URLs' paths, and the Direct Sign-In callback when a Company lists direct (needs a2a, and a2a.url the client_id's origin); otherwise publish what --print-company-client writes

context.description: what the messages agentd sends in a Company's conversations share of the User's situation, each field in the draft's format; nothing is shared that is not set. Needs an entry that uses `agent`

locale.description: a language tag (RFC 5646), such as en-US

share_availability.description: share user_available: whether the User has a client attached to agentd now (default false)

time_zone.description: an IANA time zone name, such as America/Los_Angeles

conversations.description: open conversations per instance, each followed by a reader (default 16); a new one is refused until one closes

in_flight.description: Company calls in flight per Company (default 4); one more is refused until one ends

seal_key.description: 32 random bytes as hex or base64, given as a secret reference: seals the Account Tokens a sign-in gives agentd, and the User ID records, so a store cannot read them. Required with a sign_in, and with a remote store (mcp, http)

standing.description: standing permissions: an operation one of them covers is confirmed with approved_by standing_permission, without asking the User. Each covers one Company, one channel and every term key of the revision; never when the Company requires the User's approval. Needs client.extensions [operations] and the cel feature

accounts.description: the labels of the User's accounts at the Company it covers, as a sign-in names them (agentd's own words, never sent); default the account labelled default alone, and the signed-out Session — so signing in to a second account never widens it

expires.description: an RFC 3339 time it stops applying at

terms.description: every term key it covers: a revision with a key outside them, or with no terms, asks the User

uses.description: how many confirms it covers, each reserved before the confirm and given back when the Company refuses it; default no limit but expires

via.description: the channel that proposed the operation: exactly one of tool (a glob of the Company tool's registered name, shop.exchange_*) or api (an api_allow operation, METHOD /path-template); an operation proposed in a conversation never matches

when.description: a CEL predicate over terms and summary; a term it reads that is missing is no match

user.description: the User this instance acts for at every Company: `operator` (default; refused when a2a.principals holds more than one operator rule) or a principal id `<role>:<id>`

egress.description: closed = an outbound MCP dial whose URL matches no services: catalog entry is refused; default open

exec.description: The guarded local command runner (default-OFF; needs --features exec).

policies.description: ordered verdicts on a tool call; first match wins, no match is allow

action.description: shadow refuses and says the call was held; it never fabricates a result

args.description: CEL over `args`, `tool` and `caller` — the only place an ARGUMENT can be judged, since grants are name patterns

principal.description: principal-id glob, for calls carrying one

tags.description: every listed trifecta tag must be present on the tool

tool.description: tool-name glob; absent matches every tool

question.description: the question put to a person for `ask`; {{tool}}, {{caller}} and {{args}} are substituted

to.description: which operator may answer an `ask` gate (only with action: ask): {role: operator} narrowed by labels, or the id `operator` — anyone else could never see the task and is refused (docs/configuration.md §12.6); unset = {role: operator}

immutable.description: refuse workflow.create/update/delete at runtime — definitions become read-only for the model, subagents and operators alike; loading from config/file/url/dir is unaffected

services.description: the service catalog: the named external services this deployment may use; mcp.servers entries reference entries via `service:` and may only narrow them

dir.description: a local folder of skill files (frontmatter + body, or <name>/SKILL.md); `skills/` beside the config is adopted when this is unset

work.description: default durability CLASS for runs + subagent records: ephemeral = nothing persists unless a workflow/spawn says durable: true (the fast path); default durable

max_value_bytes.description: refuse a durable write larger than this; set it when the store's READ limit is lower than its write limit (an MCP store behind a broker often caps a tool RESULT well below its request body), so a checkpoint that could not be read back is refused at write time instead of failing the next restore

retention.description: what to keep once a record is finished; unset keeps everything

keep_last.description: keep at most this many terminal runs

keep at most this many terminal A2A tasks — one bound across every principal, so on a shared listener one caller's finished tasks can push out another's; prefer ttl there. A settled task nobody has read back yet is kept for at least 30s after it settles, whatever keep_last and ttl say, so a blocking SendMessage still gets its own answer

subagents.description: subagent templates + spawn policy: operator-declared definitions the model may instantiate, filling declared params only

allow_freeform.description: false = templates are the ONLY spawn path (freeform flat-tier instruction spawns are refused); default true

defaults.description: applied to every spawn unless overridden at the template or call site

durable.description: default durability class for spawns (false = memory-only records)

describe.description: operator annotation appended beneath the tool's own description

narrow.description: append-only narrowing of an existing tool (a :::!override block): add tags, append a note; never widen

vars.description: operator-defined constants; reference anywhere (and in workflows) as {{config.NAME}} — dotted paths reach nested values, unresolved references refuse startup

listen.description: https://host:port (loopback http:// for dev) — the inbound webhook surface

url.description: the URL the listener is reached at from outside (https://host[:port][/prefix]); callback URLs are built on it

workflows.description: inline workflow definitions, or {name, file|uri|url} / {name, dir} references
